description: Share locally connected USB devices with other machines, including WSL 2.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires admin rights to $cmd"; break }
if (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\usbipd-win') { throw 'An existing system installation was detected. Uninstall it before installing with Scoop.' }

script: if ($p.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "usbipd-win MSI installation failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)." }
if ($p.ExitCode -eq 3010) { warn 'A restart is required to complete installation.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to restore $backup; the backup was retained." }

pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires admin rights to $cmd"; break }

script: if (!(Test-Path "Registry::$key")) { throw "Registry key $key is missing; refusing to overwrite the backup." }

if ($name -eq 'Devices' -and (Get-ChildItem "Registry::$key" | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.PSPath 'Attached') })) { throw 'A device is still attached; detach all devices before uninstalling.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to back up $key; uninstall aborted." }
if ($p.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "usbipd-win MSI uninstall failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)." }
if ($p.ExitCode -eq 3010) { warn 'A restart is required to complete uninstallation.' }

notes: Install, update and uninstall from an elevated PowerShell session. The MSI installs system-wide drivers, a service and a firewall rule.
The MSI manages PATH. Open a new terminal after installation.

Device bindings and policy live in HKLM, not in configuration files. Scoop backs them up to its persist directory during uninstall and restores them on reinstall; active USB connections are not preserved.
Uninstalling restores the original drivers of force-bound devices. These devices may need to be force-bound again after reinstalling.
